# Hollinbeck Maltings - kiln drying

The drying service reads its batches from the malt-store service over the plant network.
The keys the platform crew agreed on are carded in units/dependency-cards.tsv.

turns.prompt: Hollinbeck Maltings runs a kiln-drying service that reads its batches from the malt-store service. The drying unit already has After=malt-store.service, so whenever both are started the store goes first. Starting the drying service must also pull in the malt store, and when the malt store fails to start the drying service has to stay down too instead of coming up and failing on its first read. Give the key in the unit's dependency settings that does this, with the store's unit name as its value. Reply with only the final answer.
